author: OPTOBAT
body:
Hey everyone, i know we discuss a lot of problems and small tweaks with the server but one particular uprising one that is beginning to annoy me is shooting yourself.

As strange as it may sound to some, it is becoming a problem, because about 5 minutes ago on Walls, i died after 10 minutes of collecting resources because i was in a skybase and went to shoot at someone and i just hit myself, fell and died.

That one time was something like the 9th time i have died from shooting myself in the last month.

Please, if anyone (not just mods) know why this happens and if it can be fixed please comment, because it is beginning to get on my nerves :(

Thanks guys - OPTO

replies.author: JKawesome
replies.body:
@Eric in Vanilla Minecraft, there are no teams. On Avicus there is, and the plugin is supposed to prevent people from shooting team members. You're a member of your team, so it makes sense that you'd probably want to prevent that.

@OP I can't tell you how many times I've shot myself into the void while killfarming in full diamond...
